description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the DataGroupDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests data access methods related to DataGroup entities, including retrieval of permissions, data groups, and individual data group data.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for DataGroupDao, verifying data retrieval functions related to data groups and permissions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loads fixtures, and instantiates DataGroupDao.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieval of data group permissions and verifies expected values.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Verifies that the correct number of data groups are retrieved.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupsNoneDefined
methods.description: Ensures that zero data groups are returned when the underlying table is empty.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieving specific data groups by their identifiers.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupInvalid
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when requesting a non-existent data group.
